sources.use: Structure of 11 bird-name characters missing from Make Me a Hanzi, and Thai meanings of meaning parts.

三.hint: Three parallel lines; compare 一 (yī) (one) and 二 (èr) (two)

东.hint: Simplified form of 東 (dōng), the sun 日 (rì) rising behind a tree 木 (mù)

丝.hint: Simplified form of 絲 (sī), two threads

中.hint: A line 丨 (shù) through the center of a box 口 (kǒu)

丹.hint: A red pellet 丶 (diǎn) from a mine 井 (jǐng)

丽.hint: Simplified form of 麗 (lì); the antlers of a deer 鹿 (lù)

乌.hint: Simplified form of 烏 (wū); a crow (อีกา); compare 鸟 (niǎo)

亚.hint: Picture of a cross-shaped house or temple

仓.hint: Simplified form of 倉 (cāng); grains 食 (shí) kept in storage 口 (kǒu)

休.hint: A person 亻 (rén) leaning against a tree 木 (mù)

兀.hint: Cutting 一 (yī) off the feet 儿 (ér)

光.hint: A person 儿 (ér) carrying a torch 火 (huǒ)

军.hint: Soldiers 冖 (mì) (distorted 力 (lì)) in a cart 车 (chē)

冠.hint: A man 元 (yuán) puts on a cap 冖 (mì) with his hand 寸 (cùn)

凤.semanticMeaning: simplified form of 鳥 (niǎo) bird (นก)
凤.semanticThai: นก (รูปย่อของ 鳥)

加.hint: Supporting a cause with the strength 力 (lì) of one's words 口 (kǒu)

劳.hint: A man lifting 力 (lì) a load 冖 (mì) of grass 艹 (cǎo)

勺.hint: A spoon 勹 (bāo) with something in it 丶 (diǎn)

北.hint: Two people 匕 (bǐ) sitting back-to-back; phonetic loan for "north"

半.hint: A cow 牛 (niú) splitting 丷 (ha) wood in half

印.hint: A hand 爪 (zhǎo) stamping a seal 卩 (jié)

厚.hint: Sunlight 日 (rì) and children 子 (zi) in a building 厂 (chǎng)

叉.hint: A hand 又 (yòu) grasping an object 丶 (diǎn)

反.hint: A hand 又 (yòu) held up against a cliff 厂 (chǎng)

古.hint: Words passing through ten 十 (shí) mouths 口 (kǒu)

哥.hint: One person talking 可 (kě) over another 可 (kě)

喜.hint: Singing 口 (kǒu) and beating drums 壴 (zhù)

噪.hint: The sound 口 (kǒu) of birds (นก) chirping 喿 (zào); 喿 (zào) also provides the pronunciation

四.hint: A child 儿 (ér) in a room with four walls 囗 (wéi)

声.hint: Simplified form of 聲 (shēng); see that character for the etymology

夜.hint: A person 亻 (rén) sneaking by under cover 亠 (tóu) of night 夕 (xī)

大.hint: A man 人 (rén) with outstretched arms

天.hint: The heavens 一 (yī) above a man 大 (dà)

太.hint: A giant 大 (dà) with a normal-sized man 丶 (diǎn) for scale

奇.hint: A person 大 (dà) riding a horse 可 (kě)

姬.hint: An official 臣 (chén) woman 女 (nǚ)

孔.hint: The mouth 乚 (gōu) of a crying baby 子 (zi)

宝.hint: Jade 玉 (yù) kept in one's house 宀 (gài)

宾.hint: A solider 兵 (bīng) quartered under one's roof 宀 (gài)

小.hint: Dividing 八 (bā) by a line 亅 (jué)

尖.hint: A point, small 小 (xiǎo) over big 大 (dà)

尾.hint: A furry 毛 (máo) tail behind a body 尸 (shī)

岛.hint: A bird (นก) 鸟 (niǎo) perched atop a mountain 山 (shān)

岩.hint: The rocks 石 (shí) that make up a mountain 山 (shān)

崖.hint: A mountain 山 (shān) precipice 厓 (yá); 厓 (yá) also provides the pronunciation

巨.hint: A hand holding a large carpenter's square 工 (gōng)

布.hint: Cloth 巾 (jīn) held in a hand

带.hint: A belt, creasing one's robe above 卅 (sà) but not below 巾 (jīn)

幽.hint: Small niches 幺 (yāo) in the mountainside 山 (shān); 幺 (yāo) also provides the pronunciation

库.hint: A stable 广 (guǎng) where carriages 车 (chē) are parked

度.hint: Twenty 廿 (niàn) people 又 (yòu) meeting inside a building 广 (guǎng) to deliberate

异.hint: Simplified form of 異 (yì); a person 共 (gòng) with a scary face田 (tián)

弄.hint: Two hands 廾 (gǒng) playing with a piece of jade 玉 (yù); 廾 (gǒng) also provides the pronunciation

弗.hint: Two arrows 丨 (shù) pulled across a bow

弯.hint: Like 亦 (yì) a bow 弓 (gōng)

律.hint: To walk 彳 (chì) as required by law 聿 (yù)

思.hint: Weighing something with your mind 囟 (xìn) (altered) and heart 心 (xīn)

扇.hint: A feathered 羽 (yǔ) fan in the shape of a folding door 户 (hù)

斑.hint: Markings 文 (wén) in jade 王 (wáng)

新.hint: A freshly chopped 斤 (jīn) tree 亲 (qīn)

旋.hint: An army 方 (fāng) marching under a flag 疋 (pǐ)

旦.hint: The sun 日 (rì) rising over the horizon 一 (yī)

普.hint: Everyone 並 (bìng) under the sun 日 (rì)

暴.hint: A man with head 日 (rì) and hands 共 (gòng) tormenting a deer 水 (shuǐ)

本.hint: A tree 木 (mù) with its roots highlighted

朱.hint: The color of the sap 一 (yī) of some trees 木 (mù)

杓.hint: A wooden 木 (mù) spoon 勺 (sháo)

林.hint: Two trees 木 (mù) representing a forest

果.hint: Fruit 田 (tián) growing on a tree 木 (mù)

栗.hint: A tree 木 (mù) bearing nuts 覀 (xī); compare 果 (guǒ)

棉.hint: Silk 帛 (bó) picked off a tree 木 (mù)

比.hint: Two spoons 匕 (bǐ) side-by-side; 匕 (bǐ) also provides the pronunciation

水.hint: A river running between two banks; compare 川 (chuān)

法.hint: The course 去 (qù) followed by a stream 氵 (shuǐ)

泰.hint: Water 氺 (shui) contained by a dam

洲.hint: A state 州 (zhōu) surrounded by water 氵 (shuǐ); 州 (zhōu) also provides the pronunciation

渔.hint: To fish 鱼 (yú) in a river氵 (shuǐ); 鱼 (yú) also provides the pronunciation

游.hint: To swim freely 斿 (yóu) through the seas 氵 (shuǐ)

灰.hint: The remains of a fire 火 (huǒ); 火 (huǒ) also provides the pronunciation

燕.hint: A swallow (นกนางแอ่น), with its head 廿 (niàn), wings 北 (běi), and tail 灬 (huǒ)

犀.hint: An ox 牛 (niú) with a tail 尾 (wěi)

玉.hint: A necklace 丨 (shù) adorned with three pieces of jade

王.hint: A man 十 (shí) bridging heaven and earth (both 一 (yī))

琴.hint: Two guitar strings 玨 (jué) suggest the meaning; 今 (jīn) provides the pronunciation

甘.hint: Picture of a tongue with 一 (yī) marking the sweet spot

田.hint: The plots of a rice paddy

画.hint: A painting on an easel; compare 畫 (huà), which includes the brush

番.hint: Sowing seeds 米 (mǐ) on the farm 田 (tián)

疆.hint: A bow 弓 (gōng) and arrow 土 (tǔ) used to defend a border 畺 (jiāng); 畺 (jiāng) also provides the pronunciation

痣.hint: The mark 志 (zhì) of an illness 疒 (nè); 志 (zhì) also provides the pronunciation

白.hint: A burning candle; the rays of the sun

皇.hint: A crown 白 (bái) on the head of the emperor 王 (wáng)

相.hint: To stare 目 (mù) at a tree 木 (mù), meaning to observe

眉.hint: Picture of hair 尸 (shī) above an eye 目 (mù)

矛.hint: A spear pointed up and to the right

石.hint: A rock 口 (kǒu) at the base of a cliff 厂 (chǎng)

禾.hint: A plant stalk with a sagging head

秃.hint: Grains of hair 禾 (hé) on a person's head 几 (jǐ)

秋.hint: The time of year when farmers would burn 禾 (hé) crops 火 (huǒ)

科.hint: A hand measuring 斗 (dòu) grain 禾 (hé)

美.hint: A person 大 (dà) wearing an elegant crown 羊 (yáng)

肉.hint: Meat on the ribs of an animal

肩.hint: A man bringing home meat ⺼ (ròu) for the family 户 (hù)

胸.hint: A heart ⺼ (ròu) in the chest 匈 (xiōng); 匈 (xiōng) also provides the pronunciation

腿.hint: Flesh ⺼ (ròu) used to walk 退 (tuì); 退 (tuì) also provides the pronunciation

膀.hint: Flesh ⺼ (ròu) beside 旁 (páng) the body; 旁 (páng) also provides the pronunciation

花.hint: A flower 艹 (cǎo) in bloom 化 (huà); 化 (huà) also provides the pronunciation

莺.hint: A bird (นก) 鸟 (niǎo) covered in 冖 (mì) green 艹 (cǎo) feathers

虎.hint: A tiger 虍 (hū) standing on a rock 几 (jǐ); 虍 (hū) also provides the pronunciation

血.hint: A chalice 皿 (mǐn) filled with blood 丿 (piě)

西.hint: A bird (นก) settling into its nest, representing sunset; compare 東 (dōng)

角.hint: A rhinoceros or other animal horn

豆.hint: An old serving dish 口 (kǒu) on a stand with a lid 一 (yī)

贺.hint: To add 加 (jiā) to someone else's fortune 贝 (bèi)

赤.hint: A person 土 (tǔ) whose cheeks are burning 火 (huǒ)

足.hint: The leg 口 (kǒu) above the foot

遗.hint: To leave 辶 (chuò) something valuable 贵 (guì) behind

酒.hint: A jar 酉 (yǒu) of wine 氵 (shuǐ); 酉 (yǒu) also provides the pronunciation

里.hint: Unit of measure for farm 田 (tián) land 土 (tǔ)

针.hint: A metal 钅 (jīn) pin 十 (shí)

钩.hint: A metal 钅 (jīn) hook 勾 (gōu); 勾 (gōu) also provides the pronunciation

锦.hint: Silk 帛 (bó) inlaid with gold 钅 (jīn); 钅 (jīn) also provides the pronunciation

长.hint: Simplified form of 長 (zhǎng); an old man with long hair and a cane

阳.hint: The place 阝 (yì) of the sun 日 (rì); compare 阴 (yīn)

雀.hint: A small 小 (xiǎo) bird (นก) 隹 (zhuī)

雨.hint: Rain drops falling from a cloud 帀 (zā)

雷.hint: A storm 雨 (yǔ) over the fields 田 (tián)

霍.hint: Birds (นก) 隹 (zhuī) caught in a sudden storm 雨 (yǔ)

须.hint: Hair 彡 (shān) growing on the face 页 (yè)

颊.hint: The jaw in 夹 (jiā) the head 页 (yè); 夹 (jiā) also provides the pronunciation

食.hint: A dish of food 良 (liáng) with a lid on top 人 (rén)

马.hint: Simplified form of 馬 (mǎ), a horse galloping to the left

鬼.hint: A ghost with a scary face

鸟.hint: Simplified form of 鳥 (niǎo), a bird (นก)

鸡.hint: Another 又 (yòu) kind of bird (นก) 鸟 (niǎo)

鸻.hint: A wading 行 (xíng) bird (นก) 鸟 (niǎo); 鸟 (niǎo) also provides the pronunciation

麦.hint: Simplified form of 麦 (mài); grains 來 (lái) ready to be harvested 夂 (zhǐ)

麻.hint: Hemp plants 林 (lín) growing in a greenhouse 广 (guǎng)

黍.hint: Grain 禾 (hé) that can be fermented to make wine 氺 (shui)

黑.hint: A man's face blacked by soot from a fire 灬 (huǒ)
